definitions.explanation: An informal, somewhat masculine word for breakfast. Less polite than {朝|あさ}ご{飯|はん}.

examples.notes: Literally "before breakfast" — an expression meaning something is very easy.

examples.japanese: {今日|きょう}は{忙|いそが}しくて{朝飯|あさめし}を{食|た}べる{時間|じかん}がなかった。
examples.english: I was so busy today that I didn't have time to eat breakfast.

notes:
USAGE:
An informal word for breakfast, typically used by men or in casual settings. {朝|あさ}ご{飯|はん} is the standard neutral term. Often heard in the set expression {朝飯|あさめし}{前|まえ} (literally "before breakfast"), meaning something is extremely easy.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {朝飯|あさめし}{前|まえ} (a piece of cake; very easy)
- {朝飯|あさめし}を{食|く}う (to eat breakfast — informal)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {朝|あさ}ご{飯|はん}: breakfast — standard, neutral
- {朝食|ちょうしょく}: breakfast — formal
- {昼飯|ひるめし}: lunch — same informal register
